questions.prompt: What is the forecast horizon?
questions.gate: Every artifact has one horizon and generation timestamp.

questions.prompt: What outcome is modeled?
questions.gate: Regulation-plus-overtime scores, ties, and pushes reconcile to one normalized distribution.

questions.prompt: What does confidence mean?
questions.gate: Calibration, sharpness, coverage, stability, freshness, and support remain separate.

questions.prompt: Which forecast is the public headline?
questions.gate: Model-only, market-only, shrunk, and scenario-weighted labels remain stable.

questions.prompt: What is the exact market baseline?
questions.gate: Book, point, price, capture time, de-vig, and point translation are frozen.

questions.prompt: Was every value available at the forecast timestamp?
questions.gate: Maximum-source-time assertion passes.

questions.prompt: Can the raw source version be reconstructed?
questions.gate: Hash, source URL or release, schema, and capture time resolve.

questions.prompt: What changed across source regimes?
questions.gate: Coverage matrix and regime version exist before model use.

questions.prompt: How are entities resolved through changes?
questions.gate: Stable IDs and aliases are auditable; unresolved identities abort affected updates.

questions.prompt: What happens when a source is missing or partial?
questions.gate: Atomic abort, stale state, alert, and last-good preservation.

questions.prompt: Is historical weather forecast-as-issued?
questions.gate: Training information matches the live forecast horizon.

questions.prompt: Who is authoritative for current availability and roof state?
questions.gate: Official hierarchy and lower-confidence evidence are documented.

questions.prompt: May data and derived artifacts be redistributed?
questions.gate: License inventory and release policy are approved before ingestion.

questions.prompt: What is the simplest baseline the challenger must beat?
questions.gate: Unconditional, SRS, QB-Elo, market, and market-score baselines share rows.

questions.prompt: Does the joint distribution improve decisions or only coherence?
questions.gate: Joint and derived-market proper scores plus reconciliation tests pass.

questions.prompt: Does possession simulation earn its complexity?
questions.gate: Preregistered held-out lift and operational reliability pass.

questions.prompt: How is early-season uncertainty handled?
questions.gate: Priors and decay are validated only in offseason rolling-origin tests.

questions.prompt: How is double counting prevented?
questions.gate: Nested baselines, grouped ablations, shrinkage, and residual diagnostics pass.

questions.prompt: Are effects stable across seasons and eras?
questions.gate: Season and era diagnostics pass without hand-picked exclusions.

questions.prompt: Is the interpretation causal or associational?
questions.gate: Causal language requires a causal design; otherwise label associations.

questions.prompt: What is the probability of each material role state?
questions.gate: State probability has source, timestamp, confidence, and prospective calibration.

questions.prompt: Which state deserves a scenario branch?
questions.gate: A frozen materiality rule—not narrative interest—controls branching.

questions.prompt: What if a material state lacks a defensible probability?
questions.gate: Result is indeterminate; no probability is invented.

questions.prompt: Do player features add lift beyond team and quarterback state?
questions.gate: Position-group ablation passes on all games and personnel-change games.

questions.prompt: What concrete fact or price changes the conclusion?
questions.gate: Every fragile dossier names a recomputable state or threshold.

questions.prompt: Are all candidates scored on the same rows?
questions.gate: Evaluation-row hashes are identical.

questions.prompt: Was the primary metric frozen before fitting?
questions.gate: Registry timestamp predates result artifacts.

questions.prompt: How good is the full distribution?
questions.gate: Joint score, CRPS, PIT, covariance, key-score, tail, tie, and push diagnostics exist.

questions.prompt: Are probabilities calibrated in level and slope?
questions.gate: Intercept, slope, uncertainty, and reliability bins with counts exist.

questions.prompt: Do intervals cover prospectively?
questions.gate: Sequential coverage and width are reported by horizon and regime.

questions.prompt: How uncertain is measured improvement?
questions.gate: Game, week, or season-blocked intervals and unique-game counts exist.

questions.prompt: How many related specifications were tested?
questions.gate: Experiment-family count and multiplicity-aware decision are recorded.

questions.prompt: Does improvement survive stability slices?
questions.gate: Season, era, horizon, market-band, and missingness report exists.

questions.prompt: Can hashes reproduce the result?
questions.gate: Deterministic replay passes before promotion.

questions.prompt: What exact book contract is compared?
questions.gate: Book, side, point, price, and timestamp are frozen.

questions.prompt: What counts as the close?
questions.gate: Last complete named-book quote strictly before kickoff is used.

questions.prompt: Was closing value translated correctly?
questions.gate: De-vig, discrete move, hold reapplied, cents, and points reproduce.

questions.prompt: Did the forecast add information beyond current price?
questions.gate: Market-residual and market-only comparisons cover all eligible forecasts.

questions.prompt: Are sharp or public signals actually latency artifacts?
questions.gate: Method, sample, timestamps, and next-reference-quote test pass.

questions.prompt: Did selection hide losing or missing forecasts?
questions.gate: All-game scorecard and selected-opportunity scorecard both report coverage.

questions.prompt: Can a browser visit mutate state or spend quota?
questions.gate: Public paths are read-only; leases are idempotent.

questions.prompt: What is served after failure?
questions.gate: Last-good forecast, stale provenance, alert, and no partial mutation.

questions.prompt: Was data, coefficient, or structure changed?
questions.gate: Separate versions and cadence permissions are visible.

questions.prompt: Can an unlogged model forecast?
questions.gate: Forecast path requires registry resolution.

questions.prompt: Can production roll back safely?
questions.gate: Prior champion, config, and data snapshot remain deployable.

questions.prompt: Does public release contain secrets or restricted data?
questions.gate: Secret, license, personal-record, and public-clone checks pass.

questions.prompt: Can a user understand the disagreement quickly?
questions.gate: Usability test identifies direction, uncertainty, and falsifier.

questions.prompt: Can a person disagree without rewriting the model?
questions.gate: Model forecast and timestamped human adjustment are immutable and separate.

questions.prompt: Did human judgment improve the forecast?
questions.gate: Model-only and adjusted distributions use the same prospective proper score.

questions.prompt: Is a repeated human insight a label or hypothesis?
questions.gate: It enters the experiment registry and never direct fitting.

questions.prompt: What did the model miss versus game variance?
questions.gate: Review compares pregame distribution and source state; surprise alone is not a miss.

questions.prompt: What evidence abandons the approach?
questions.gate: Every major hypothesis has a falsifier and rejected results remain visible.
